database_service.name: clickhouse-riigikogu
database_service.description: ClickHouse data warehouse for Estonian Parliament (Riigikogu) voting data analysis with Tallinn weather correlation

databases.name: gold
databases.description: Gold layer containing fact and dimension tables for Riigikogu voting analysis. This is the presentation layer optimized for analytical queries and BI tools.

databases.name: parliament_data
databases.description: Bronze layer containing raw parliament voting data ingested from the Riigikogu API (api.riigikogu.ee).

databases.name: weather_data
databases.description: Bronze layer containing raw weather data from Tallinn-Harku meteorological station (2004-2024).

FactVoting.description: Central fact table containing all Riigikogu (Estonian Parliament) voting events. Each row represents a single voting session with metrics like attendance, vote counts, and references to dimension tables for weather conditions and date attributes.

columns.VotingId: Unique surrogate key for each voting record (cityHash64 of uuid)
columns.VotingSrcId: Original voting UUID from the Riigikogu API source system
columns.VotingType: Foreign key reference to DimVotingType dimension table (type_code from API)
columns.WeatherId: Foreign key reference to DimWeather dimension table, linking Tallinn weather conditions during the voting
columns.Date: Foreign key reference to DimDate dimension table
columns.StartTime: Timestamp when the voting session began
columns.EndTime: Timestamp when the voting session concluded
columns.VotingDescription: Official description/title of the voting topic from Riigikogu records
columns.Present: Count of Riigikogu members physically present during the vote
columns.Absent: Count of Riigikogu members who were absent during the vote
columns.InFavour: Count of Riigikogu members who voted YES/in favor of the motion
columns.Against: Count of Riigikogu members who voted NO/against the motion
columns.Neutral: Count of Riigikogu members who abstained or voted neutral
columns.Abstained: Count of Riigikogu members who explicitly abstained from voting

DimWeather.description: Weather dimension table containing aggregated meteorological data from Tallinn-Harku station. Each record represents a 6-hour time window, used to analyze potential correlation between weather conditions and parliamentary voting patterns.

columns.WeatherId: Unique surrogate key for each weather record
columns.StartTime: Start timestamp of the 6-hour weather aggregation window
columns.EndTime: End timestamp of the 6-hour weather aggregation window
columns.AvgTemp: Average temperature in Celsius during the 6-hour period
columns.HighTemp: Maximum temperature in Celsius recorded during the period
columns.LowTemp: Minimum temperature in Celsius recorded during the period
columns.AvgPrecipitation: Average precipitation in mm during the 6-hour period
columns.MaxPrecipitation: Maximum precipitation intensity in mm recorded during the period
columns.AvgWindSpeed: Average wind speed in m/s during the period
columns.MaxWindSpeed: Maximum wind gust speed in m/s recorded during the period

DimDate.description: Date dimension table providing calendar attributes for time-based analysis. Enables slicing and dicing voting data by various time hierarchies and identifying patterns around Estonian holidays.

columns.Date: Primary key - the calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format
columns.WeekDay: Day of the week (Monday=1 through Sunday=7)
columns.HolidayInd: Boolean indicator: 1 if the date is an Estonian public holiday, 0 otherwise
columns.HolidayDesc: Name/description of the Estonian holiday if HolidayInd=1, NULL otherwise
columns.Year: Four-digit year extracted from the date
columns.Month: Month number (1-12) extracted from the date
columns.Season: Season classification: Spring, Summer, Autumn, or Winter

DimVotingType.description: Voting type dimension table categorizing different types of Riigikogu votes. Used to analyze voting patterns across different procedural categories.

columns.VotingType: Primary key - unique code identifying the voting type (from Riigikogu API type.code)
columns.VotingTypeDesc: Human-readable description of the voting type category (from Riigikogu API type.value)

glossary.name: Riigikogu Data Glossary
glossary.description: Business glossary for Estonian Parliament (Riigikogu) voting data warehouse terms

terms.name: Riigikogu
terms.description: The unicameral parliament of Estonia, consisting of 101 members elected for four-year terms

terms.name: Voting Session
terms.description: A formal Riigikogu procedure where members cast votes on proposed legislation, motions, or amendments

terms.name: Sitting
terms.description: A parliamentary session during which multiple votings may occur, identified by sitting_title and sitting_date in the source data

terms.name: Tallinn-Harku
terms.description: The meteorological observation station near Tallinn providing weather data for this analysis

terms.name: Bronze Layer
terms.description: Raw data layer containing unprocessed data directly from source systems (Riigikogu API, Tallinn-Harku weather Excel)

terms.name: Gold Layer
terms.description: Presentation layer containing cleansed, transformed, and aggregated data optimized for analytical queries

dashboard_service.name: superset-riigikogu
dashboard_service.description: Apache Superset dashboards for Estonian Parliament (Riigikogu) voting data visualization and weather correlation analysis

dashboards.name: riigikogu-voting-analysis
dashboards.description: Analytics dashboard exploring the correlation between weather conditions and Estonian Parliament (Riigikogu) voting patterns. Answers business questions: How do temperature, precipitation, and wind affect parliamentary attendance and voting consensus? How does the day of the week influence voting behavior?

charts.name: temperature-vs-attendance
charts.description: Scatter plot with trendline showing correlation between average temperature (AvgTemp from DimWeather) and attendance rate (Present/101). Answers: Does warmer weather lead to higher attendance?

charts.name: weather-consensus-heatmap
charts.description: Heatmap showing consensus rate (max(InFavour,Against,Neutral)/Total) across temperature ranges and precipitation levels. Answers: Is consensus higher when weather is pleasant?

charts.name: weekday-attendance-bar
charts.description: Bar chart showing average attendance rate grouped by WeekDay from DimDate. Answers: Which days have highest/lowest parliamentary attendance?
